unit.why: A narrative about the Berdichever asking the Kozienice Maggid for his silver Hanukkah menorah and promising it to the yet-unborn child (R. Meir of Apta), with the prediction fulfilled.
unit.boundary_note: part of a sequence on the birth of the tsaddik; the next division continues with his circumcision

stories.start_quote: והנה לידת מרן זצ"ל היה ג"כ
stories.end_quote: היה מדליק מרן זצ״ל כל ימי חייו
stories.summary_en: Before the birth of the hero (R. Meir), R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev, visiting Kozienice, asked the Maggid for his silver Hanukkah menorah and declared it a gift for the son to be born to the Maggid's daughter, to be given at his wedding; so it was, and the tsaddik lit it all his life.
